# Western Cars Brighton

> Western Cars Brighton is a licensed private hire operator serving Brighton and Hove, West Sussex, and nearby areas since 2007. The company provides local taxi journeys, airport transfers, corporate travel, event hire, and accessible taxi services.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.westerncarsbrighton.co.uk/): Overview of taxi services and coverage.
- [About Western Cars](https://www.westerncarsbrighton.co.uk/about-us/): Company information.
- [Taxi services](https://www.westerncarsbrighton.co.uk/airport-transfers-brighton/): Airport transfers and related services.
- [Reviews](https://www.westerncarsbrighton.co.uk/reviews/): Customer reviews.
- [Contact](https://www.westerncarsbrighton.co.uk/contact-us/): Contact details and enquiries.
- [Terms and privacy](https://www.westerncarsbrighton.co.uk/terms/): Booking terms and privacy information.
